digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding and duplicate prevention
propositions: DC Lucene index eventual consistency with lag up to 2991 seconds causes recover_pending to unbind keyless-pending entries on a single negative search, leaving no record to prevent a duplicate create

create_one dedup gate checks only get_jira_key(local_id) is None, which returns None for keyless-pending entries, so suppressing unbind alone does not prevent the duplicate without also gating at the write site
a keyless-pending binding younger than a grace period (default 3600s) must defer the create via the gate in create_one, not only prevent unbinding in recover_pending
recover_pending must record search_miss_count on keyless-branch misses and unbind only after both search_miss_count >= 3 and entry age exceeds the grace period
create_one must consult is_keyless_pending_within_grace accessor and defer creates for keyless-pending bindings inside the grace window to prevent duplicate issue creation
recover_pending return value must not count still-pending entries as resolved, to accurately reflect unsettled bindings
